question: Should CodexBar expose an opt-in setting that allows one claude-swap account, including a sentinel-only account, to replace the ambient Claude presentation?
rationale: The earlier merged claude-swap and CLI work deliberately used a two-or-more-account threshold; whether an explicit single-account override belongs in the supported provider UX is a product boundary that tests cannot determine.

options.title: Adopt the opt-in boundary
options.body: Accept the default-off setting after real one-account evidence confirms the menu and CLI behavior while preserving zero-account and explicit-override fallback.

options.title: Keep multi-account-only precedence
options.body: Retain the existing two-or-more-account rule and close this direction if single-account replacement is not a supported Claude workflow.

recommendation.title: Adopt the opt-in boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the default-off setting after real one-account evidence confirms the menu and CLI behavior while preserving zero-account and explicit-override fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged claude-swap feature whose established account-count boundary this PR changes.
